name: Microgrid voltage-support reserve indication
aliases: microgrids Microgrid voltage and reactive-power controls
summary: Identifies the declared remaining resource capability for assigned voltage-support action.
description: Identifies the declared remaining resource capability for assigned voltage-support action. Voltage and reactive-power control coordinate the AC operating condition of the microgrid resources. A voltage target, reactive-power target and power-factor target represent different control objectives and should have explicit ownership.

In an islanded microgrid, the assigned reference source supports bus voltage while other compatible resources share reactive demand according to the selected control method. Grid-connected operation can use a different objective at the PCC. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Resource reactive capability and output” at the input and “Voltage-support headroom” at the output. Headroom is not guaranteed disturbance performance.
